name: Worn By The Forgotten
description:
About This Game

Worn By The Forgotten is a 3D puzzle-adventure about a single mask and the four divine beasts sleeping within. As Worn, the girl who finds the mask of a forgotten god, set out with the divine beasts at your side.

Awakened Companions

The mask summons a divine beast to Worn's side. Switch between Worn and the beast at any time, and adventure together.

Four Divine Beasts, Four Powers

Each beast has its own way of moving the world. The Owl's wings lift what hands cannot, the Bull's horns smash through solid walls, the Deer's light cuts through the dark, and the Snake's body slips through gaps too narrow to cross.

Worn's Dagger

Worn's dagger holds the power of the divine beasts. Throw and catch it to trigger switches out of reach, and pair it with each beast's ability to open new paths.

Ever-Shifting Trials

Every puzzle bends to the beast you bring. Choose carefully at each step, and face the greater trials waiting at the end of the path.

Since the day Worn found the mask, a strange voice has been calling to her. Walk beside her as she follows that call — wherever the Forgotten may lead.
short_desc: A forgotten god, worshipped in countless forms, was vanquished by the evil deity Yanutan—but left behind a mask holding four beliefs and the divine beasts that embody them. As Worn, the girl who finds it, wield the beasts, uncover the world's lost secrets, and overcome every trial.
